title: fix(mcp): the metadata tools and list_actions answer a fault the way /meta does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEu46tqSFAu4asLNt91sQgz)_

Fixes #31272

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP 的 `list_objects`、`describe_object`、`validate_expression`、`list_actions` 四个工具,在后端读取出故障(连接断开、数据库驱动错误等)时,不再把原始错误文字或驱动错误码交给 agent;现在和 `/meta` 接口一样答 `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` / `Internal server error`(驱动错误答 `500 DATABASE_ERROR` / `Internal data error`),原文只写进服务端日志。
- 为什么改:`/meta` 接口对同样的故障早已这样回答;MCP 这四个工具却原样转交,例如把 `SQLITE_BUSY` 当成业务拒绝码交给 agent。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `@objectstack/mcp`,新增一个小函数,判断全部调用 `@objectstack/types` 里 `/meta` 已经在用的同一套函数,没有复制。业务拒绝(4xx)原样不变。可见变化:对象字段可见性无法评估时(`FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` / 503),错误码和状态不变,说明文字改为 `Internal server error`,与 `/meta` 对象读取一致。回滚即 revert。patch。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `metaDoorErrorResult`;`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 末尾的 #31272 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts -t 31272`,预期 14 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` gains `metaDoorErrorResult(err, tool, objectName?)`, and the catches of `list_objects`, `describe_object`, `validate_expression` and `list_actions` render through it instead of `errorResultWithCode`:

- It asks `dataDoorAnswerOf(err)` with no object, which is `mapDataError` (`@objectstack/types`), and decides with `isServerFault` (`@objectstack/types`). The `/meta` read doors call `handleRouteError(res, error)` with no object, and for a fault `handleRouteError` answers `mapDataError`'s classification. So these tools ask the same reader. No part of the `/meta` classification is copied into `packages/mcp`, and nothing new is exported.
- When the door answers 5xx, the tool answers `{ error: { code, message, status } }` with the door's code, sentence and status, and the thrown value is logged once through `logServerFault` (`[5xx] STATUS tools/call TOOL [OBJECT] — …`).
- Every other throw renders through `errorResultWithCode` as before. A declared refusal keeps its code, sentence and status. A code-less 4xx keeps its bare message. This is the same line `rowRefusalOf` already draws for `delete_records`, with the same reader.
- `dataDoorAnswerOf`'s `objectName` parameter became optional. The function is not exported.

Measured, one thrown value at a time, against `handleRouteError` (rest `error-response.ts`; the doors are `GET /meta/:type` and `GET /meta/:type/:name`) and `mapDataError` with no object. The two agree on every shape below:

| Thrown by the bridge member | MCP before (all four tools) | `/meta` door | MCP now (all four tools) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `new Error('socket hang up')` | bare text `socket hang up` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` `Internal server error` | `INTERNAL_ERROR` · `Internal server error` · 500, logged once |
| `{ code: 'SQLITE_BUSY' }`, `SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked` | `{ code: SQLITE_BUSY, message: driver text }`, no status | `500 DATABASE_ERROR` `Internal data error` | `DATABASE_ERROR` · `Internal data error` · 500, logged once |
| `ECONNREFUSED`, `57P01`, a thrown string | the text, or the driver code and text | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` | `INTERNAL_ERROR` · 500, logged once |
| `FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` / 503 (both bridges' object-schema refusal) | code · its sentence · 503 | `503`, code kept, prose withheld (`sendFieldVisibilityFault`) | code · `Internal server error` · 503, logged |
| `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409; `PERMISSION_DENIED` with no status | code · sentence · status | 409 / 403, same code and sentence | unchanged |
| a code-less sandboxed abort | the wrapper text | `400 HOOK_ABORTED` | unchanged (a 4xx; not a fault) |

Per face, the pins are in the #31272 block: each of the four tools has a bare `Error` row, a `SQLITE_BUSY` row and a CONTROL row, and the three object-schema tools share the `FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` row.

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`:
  - The four rows in `SITES` are marked `metaDoor`. In the shared loop, their code-less throw now expects the door's `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, the same expectation the record data tools already have.
  - The "empty or non-string code, or a thrown string" pin moves from `list_actions` to `delete_records`, whose outer catch still renders through `errorResultWithCode` alone.
  - A new `#31272` describe block. For each tool: a bare `Error` answers `{ code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Internal server error', status: 500 }`, equal to `mapDataError(thrown)`, with no thrown text in the answer and exactly one `[5xx] 500 tools/call TOOL [task] — ` log line that carries it. `SQLITE_BUSY` answers `{ code: 'DATABASE_ERROR', message: 'Internal data error', status: 500 }`, equal to the door's answer, with neither the code nor the driver text in the answer, logged once. CONTROL: `RECORD_LOCKED` / 409 and a status-less `PERMISSION_DENIED` keep their code and sentence, and nothing is logged. Then `FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` / 503 keeps its code and status, has its sentence withheld, and equals the door's answer.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-tools.test.ts`: "surfaces list_actions bridge errors as tool errors" now expects the door's 500, with the text in the one log line.
- Red first on the base source (`mcp-http-tools.ts` at `7c523aa1`, the new tests in place): Tests 14 failed | 102 passed (116). All four CONTROL rows were green. With the fix: 116 passed.
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`if (!isServerFault(door.status))` became `if (!isServerFault(door.status) || String("ABL").length > 0)`): the mutation landed (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 38047fe8d122 -> 67386ab8cd95). Result: Tests 14 failed | 102 passed (116). Restored blob == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The tests import `src`, so no dist was involved.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` on `5838a614`: Test Files 60 passed (60), Tests 836 passed (836). The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- No crash pin. A sandboxed crash cannot reach these four members in production, because metadata reads run no record hooks. The order rules no pin is owed for it. The #31269 pin still holds: a coded crash is equal to the same crash with no code. On these faces that answer is now the door's 500.
- A code-less 4xx is out of scope. A code-less sandboxed abort still renders the runner's wrapper on these faces, where `/meta` answers `400 HOOK_ABORTED`, and no production producer reaches these members with it. The CONTROL "the tools that are not record data tools still answer a code-less throw with its bare message" still pins it.
- `FIELD_VISIBILITY_UNRESOLVED` is the one real producer whose answer moves. It is thrown by both bridges' `fieldVisibilityRefusal` (runtime `domains/mcp.ts`, mcp `stdio-data-bridge.ts`). The `/meta` object read answers it through `sendFieldVisibilityFault` as a declared server fault, with its prose withheld (#5437). These tools now answer the same. The existing pins on it (`stdio-data-bridge.object-schema-mask.test.ts`, runtime `mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`) assert code and status only and stay green. The runtime docblock on `fieldVisibilityRefusal` says it carries "the code, status and sentence the REST `/meta` object read answers". REST withholds that sentence, so that docblock is now true of what the tool serves, but not of what it throws. It is outside this claim's file surface and was not edited.
- Sibling cards on the same files: #31270 (record resource), #31271 (`run_action` / `resume_run`) and #31273 (record data tools' driver code). This PR does not touch their faces. If this PR lands after any of them, it merges `origin/main` once and re-runs the mcp suite.

## Verification
